cards.title: Free means free. Here's the deal.
cards.body: Health apps often hide the basics behind a paywall. AICA is doing it differently, so here's exactly what costs what.

cards.title: Free forever: the core patient app
cards.body: Prescriptions, dose alarms, refills and family profiles. The things you need to keep Mummy and Papa's medicines on track stay free forever.

cards.title: AICA Pro: planned, ₹600 a month
cards.body: Pro is an optional add-on, per profile, for features that need real AI work every day. It is planned, not live, and nothing is charged today.

cards.title: Pro adds a care diary
cards.body: Mood, pain, sleep and Hindi voice notes become a 30-day pattern your doctor and family can see.

cards.title: A 30-second morning check-in
cards.body: "How are you feeling today?" An AI check-in that turns the answer into structured vitals and symptoms.

cards.title: And a vitals tracker
cards.body: BP, sugar and weight in three taps, with AI flagging a rising trend early so you can talk to the doctor sooner.

cards.title: Pharmacies and clinics in the pilot
cards.body: Founding pharmacies and clinics use AICA free during the pilot, which is starting in Lucknow.

cards.title: The basics should never cost extra
cards.body: Core care free forever, Pro optional later. See the prototype and join the waitlist at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: AICA's core patient app is free forever, Pro is planned at ₹600 a month per profile, and nothing is charged today.
share: AICA's prescriptions, dose alarms, refills and family profiles: free forever. Nothing charged today.
